system.description: An Ascendant-level power in which the Baali spends Willpower Traits to set the scope of effect (one Trait for her immediate vicinity, up to five or six for an entire city) and Mental Traits to set the intensity of social discord and despair inflicted, per an escalation table (two Mental Traits per intensity step). Each Willpower Trait spent takes a full day and night to manifest. Kindred with Auspex Spirit's Touch or better may sense the disturbance's source with a Mental Challenge against the Baali, learning only vague impressions.
